annotations.title: Get a number's message quota for this billing cycle

description:
Check how much of this number's message allowance is left.

The quota is **per number**, not per organization: an organization with
three numbers has three separate allowances. It resets at `cycle_end`,
which is the organization's real billing boundary rather than a rolling
window, so `resets_at` is a date you can plan around.

Only messages sent through Turbo Notify consume it. Messages someone
sends from the phone itself do not.

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
